battle.name: 土耳其入侵塞浦路斯
battle.brief: 1974年7月，土耳其入侵塞浦路斯，土耳其軍隊先在北部凱雷尼亞地區登陸，隨後控制部分島嶼，衝突成為同年第二次行動的導火線。英國海軍於1862年列裝的Ironclad屬鐵甲蒸汽戰艦，以厚重裝甲保護艦體、承受砲火並搭載重砲，是當時艦隊的核心戰鬥平台。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 鐵甲艦是英國海軍十九世紀的主力裝甲蒸汽戰艦類型，以艦體裝甲抵禦砲火，並以舷側重砲進行遠程打擊，負責護衛與海上控制。

countries: 1974年的「土耳其入侵塞浦路斯」有兩個直接作戰面：土耳其陸軍第五軍團與受其支援的土耳其塞浦路斯部隊，對上塞浦路斯共和國國民衛隊與EOKA B。希臘不是登陸作戰方，卻是塞浦路斯武裝的重要武器、軍事顧問與指揮支援來源；英國則是1960年《保證條約》的三個保證國之一，聯合國駐塞浦路斯和平軍則以多國部隊身分監督停火線。聯合國安理會不是交戰方，但先後以第353、354及357號決議要求停止交火、恢復談判，並譴責土耳其第二次軍事介入。馬卡里奧斯三世領導的塞浦路斯共和國政府保有國家機構、外交承認與首都職能；土耳其控制北部和東部後，則形成與南部政府並存的土耳其塞浦路斯行政架構。
countriesEn: The 1974 Turkish invasion of Cyprus had two direct combat sides: the Turkish Fifth Army Corps and Turkish Cypriot forces supported by Turkey, against the National Guard of the Republic of Cyprus and EOKA B. Greece was not the amphibious belligerent, but it supplied weapons, military advisers, and command support to the Cypriot armed forces. Britain was one of the three guarantors under the 1960 Treaty of Guarantee, while the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus supervised the cease-fire lines as a multinational force. The UN Security Council was not a belligerent, but adopted Resolutions 353, 354, and 357 to call for an end to hostilities, the resumption of negotiations, and opposition to Turkey's second military intervention. The government of President Makarios III retained the state institutions, diplomatic recognition, and capital functions of the Republic of Cyprus. After Turkey took control in northern and eastern Cyprus, a Turkish Cypriot administrative structure developed alongside the southern government.
people: 土耳其總理比倫特·埃切維特（Bülent Ecevit）主持作戰決策，外長圖爾汗·費佐格盧（Turhan Feyzioğlu）代表政府發出最後通牒；實際統率第五軍團與登陸部隊的是奧斯曼·法澤爾·波拉特中將（Osman Fazıl Polat）。塞浦路斯總統馬卡里奧斯三世在1974年7月15日政變後被控制，經英國安排撤離，7月31日返回島上；前EOKA領袖喬治·格里瓦斯（George Grivas）則是EOKA B的策劃與戰鬥指揮核心，於8月15日第二階段作戰期間返島。土耳其塞浦路斯方面的主要政治代表是拉夫·登克塔什（Rauf Denktaş），他參與談判，後來主持北部行政機構。希臘軍政府於7月24日垮台，馬里納利斯 restores，但既有武器與軍事顧問並未立即全部撤出。聯合國秘書長庫爾特·瓦爾德海姆（Kurt Waldheim）及和平軍各級指揮官，負責推動停火、劃定緩衝區並安排談判。
peopleEn: Turkish Prime Minister Bülent Ecevit directed the war policy, while Foreign Minister Turhan Feyzioğlu delivered the government's final ultimatum. Lieutenant General Osman Fazıl Polat, commander of the Fifth Army Corps, exercised operational command over the landing force and ground operation. President Makarios III was confined during the coup of 15 July 1974, evacuated with British assistance, and returned to Cyprus on 31 July. George Grivas, the former EOKA leader, was the principal planner and operational commander of EOKA B and returned to the island on 15 August during the second phase. Rauf Denktaş was the principal Turkish Cypriot political interlocutor; he participated in the negotiations and later headed the northern administrative structure. The Greek military junta collapsed on 24 July and Constantine Karamanlis returned, but the existing weapons and military advisers were not immediately withdrawn. UN Secretary-General Kurt Waldheim and the commanders of the peacekeeping force worked to arrange the cease-fires, establish the buffer zone, and conduct negotiations.
kits: 土耳其海軍先以登陸艇和運輸船建立基里尼亞灘頭，第五軍團以第39步兵師為主要地面部隊，並投入M48系列帕頓主戰坦克、M113裝甲運兵車、M2系列105公厘榴彈砲、FN MAG通用機槍與勃朗寧M2重機槍；土耳其空軍的F-104星戰鬥機提供空中掩護，並在若干戰段攻擊地面目標。塞浦路斯國民衛隊與EOKA B可使用的裝甲包括M4謝爾曼坦克、AMX-13輕型坦克和潘哈德AML裝甲車，另配106公厘無後坐力砲、81公厘迫擊砲及重機槍。兩方武器形成鮮明對比：土軍以M48的正面火力、M113的兵員與彈藥輸送能力，以及可在狹窄道路上展開的砲兵支撐灘頭；塞方則把數量有限的坦克與裝甲車集中在海岸公路和山口，企圖以反擊切斷登陸區。後勤上，先行海運必須同時容納人員、坦克、105公厘砲彈、機槍彈藥、燃料、備用履帶與回收工具；M48離開海灘後依賴沿途加油、故障拖回及前方維修，傷員後送也只能利用基里尼亞至內陸的有限道路。
kitsEn: Turkish naval landing craft and transport ships first established the Kyrenia beachhead. The Fifth Army Corps used the 39th Infantry Division as a major component of its ground force, with M48-series Patton main battle tanks, M113 armored personnel carriers, M2-series 105 mm howitzers, FN MAG general-purpose machine guns, and Browning M2 heavy machine guns. Turkish Air Force F-104 Starfighters provided air cover and attacked ground targets during several phases of the fighting. The Cypriot National Guard and EOKA B fielded M4 Sherman tanks, AMX-13 light tanks, and Panhard AML armored cars, together with 106 mm recoilless rifles, 81 mm mortars, and heavy machine guns. The contrast in equipment was clear: Turkish M48s provided frontal firepower, M113s carried infantry and ammunition, and the artillery could support movement along the narrow roads. The Cypriot side concentrated its limited armor on the coastal highway and passes in an effort to cut the landing area. Logistically, the initial sea lift had to carry troops, tanks, 105 mm ammunition, machine-gun ammunition, fuel, spare tracks, and recovery equipment. Once the M48s left the beach, movement depended on fuel delivered forward, recovery of disabled vehicles, and field maintenance along a limited route from Kyrenia into the interior.
tactics: 第一階段於1974年7月20日清晨展開。首批登陸艇在基里尼亞卸下先頭部隊，後續船運把坦克、裝甲車和火砲送上海灘；土軍迅速控制舊港周邊、機場及通往內陸的主要道路，並以M48和步兵封住通往阿特拉爾（Atlılar）的狹窄路口。塞浦路斯裝甲部隊曾沿北岸公路實施反擊，試圖在登陸區尚未擴大時切斷海灘與道路，但海岸線、基里尼亞山脈（Besparmak）以及阿特拉爾一帶有限的展開空間，使坦克和裝甲車難以同時前進；土軍則利用M48的正面射界、M113的機動與砲兵支援，把反擊限制在狹窄正面。7月22日達成的第一階段停火，只把基里尼亞走廊固定下來，沿線由聯合國部隊接管，塞浦路斯方面的遠程武器與部隊仍不斷得到補給。第二階段於8月14日清晨展開。土軍從既有橋頭堡同時向數個方向推進：一支主力沿北岸公路向拉皮索斯與莫爾富方向前進；另一支利用山麓道路和側翼迂迴，試圖越過塞方依地形設置的阻擊點；東面部隊則由法馬古斯塔周邊向基奧尼亞方向推進，企圖接上原有土耳其塞浦路斯控制區。在阿聖西奧多羅斯與基奧尼亞一帶，塞方以謝爾曼、AMX-13、AML和無後坐力砲構成障礙，土軍先以砲兵和空中支援削弱陣地，再由坦克、步兵及工兵逐點突破。8月16日，土耳其正規軍進入法馬古斯塔，控制此前分裂城市的西部與中部；格里瓦斯雖已返島，卻已無法扭轉停火前景，聯合國隨即把原先局部的停火線延伸成橫跨島嶼東西的緩衝線。
tacticsEn: The first phase began early on 20 July 1974. The first landing craft put the leading troops ashore at Kyrenia, and follow-on shipping brought in tanks, armored vehicles, and artillery. Turkish forces quickly secured the old harbor area, the airport, and the principal road inland, then used M48 tanks and infantry to seal the narrow approach to Atlılar. Cypriot armored forces counterattacked along the northern coastal road in an attempt to sever the beach before it could expand, but the shoreline, the Besparmak mountain range, and the limited space for maneuver around Atlılar made it difficult to deploy tanks and armored cars together. The Turkish response used the frontal fire of the M48s, M113 mobility, and artillery support to contain the counterattack on a narrow front. The first-phase cease-fire of 22 July fixed the Kyrenia corridor under UN supervision, but long-range weapons and forces continued to reach the Cypriot side. The second phase opened at dawn on 14 August. Turkish forces advanced from the existing bridgehead in several directions: a main effort followed the northern coastal road toward Lapithos and Morphou; another used mountain tracks and flank routes to bypass terrain-based blocking positions; and an eastern force moved from the Famagusta area toward Kionia to connect with the pre-existing Turkish Cypriot positions. At Ayios Theodoros and Kionia, Shermans, AMX-13s, AMLs, and recoilless rifles formed the principal obstacles. Turkish artillery and air support weakened these positions before tanks, infantry, and engineers broke through them section by section. On 16 August, regular Turkish troops entered Famagusta and took control of its western and central sectors. Grivas had returned, but he could no longer reverse the approaching cease-fire. The UN then extended the earlier local lines into a buffer running across the island.
data: 公開戰史通常把7月20日首批登陸兵力記為約七千人、三十六輛坦克，並估算土軍在最初四十八小時內增至約三萬人；第一階段之後，土耳其一方控制區由全島約百分之十七增至約百分之二十三，第二階段結束時約占全島百分之三十六至三十八，餘下部分則由共和國政府與聯合國緩衝區分隔。關鍵日期依次是7月20日登陸、7月22日第一階段停火、7月30日第二次最後通牒、8月14日第二階段開始及8月16日法馬古斯塔方向停火。安理會第353號決議於7月20日要求停火，第354號決議於7月23日確認停火並要求談判，第357號決議於8月14日譴責土耳其進一步介入。後來核定的停火帶長約一百八十公里，多數路段狹窄。傷亡方面，土耳其軍方就登陸作戰發布的數字，一般記為陣亡1人、負傷49人；其他各方的陣亡、受傷、失聯及戰後死亡統計口徑並不一致，因此不把來源不同的數字硬加成一個總和。
dataEn: Public operational histories generally record the initial landing force on 20 July as approximately 7,000 men and 36 tanks, and estimate that Turkish strength rose to about 30,000 within the first forty-eight hours. After the first phase, Turkish-held territory increased from roughly 17 percent of the island to about 23 percent; by the end of the second phase it covered approximately 36 to 38 percent, with the remainder divided between the Republic's government-controlled areas and the UN buffer zone. The key dates were the landing on 20 July, the first cease-fire on 22 July, the second ultimatum on 30 July, the opening of the second phase on 14 August, and the cease-fire in the Famagusta sector on 16 August. Security Council Resolution 353 called for a cease-fire on 20 July; Resolution 354 endorsed the cease-fire and called for negotiations on 23 July; Resolution 357 deplored Turkey's further intervention on 14 August. The later buffer zone was approximately 180 kilometers long and narrow across most of its length. For casualties, the Turkish military figures generally published for the landing operation list 1 killed and 49 wounded. Greek Cypriot, Turkish Cypriot, missing-person, and post-combat death estimates used different definitions, so they should not be combined into a single artificial total.
cause: 直接原因出自1960年獨立後迅速惡化的安全結構。《保證條約》第四條規定，在土耳其社群與希臘社群發生「社群間紛爭」時，三個保證國可以分別或共同介入；土耳其以此作為介入的法律依據。1963年後的武裝衝突、聯合國部隊的長期駐紮、希臘與土耳其分別向島上輸送武器，以及1974年日內瓦社群談判未能解決軍事安全問題，使雙方都認為現有部署即將被對方改變。1974年7月14日，土耳其要求塞浦路斯停止外來武器流入並撤走希臘軍事人員；7月15日希臘軍政府接管雅典政權，同日以EOKA B及希臘軍官為核心的塞浦路斯政變控制馬卡里奧斯，迫使他經英國安排撤離。土耳其於7月20日登陸，宣稱是阻止政變及保護塞浦路斯土耳其社群。希臘軍政府雖在7月24日垮台，7月30日土方仍發出第二份最後通牒，文件要求國民衛隊縮減至六千名上下的原有規模，並要求六百零九人的武裝上限、清退軍事顧問及處理外來武器；經瓦爾德海姆斡旋，期限延至8月3日。8月14日第二階段展開時，土方稱塞方違反第一階段停火線並持續獲得武器；聯合國則認為這些理由不能取代已存在的停火義務。
causeEn: The immediate causes grew out of the deteriorating security structure that followed independence in 1960. Article IV of the Treaty of Guarantee stated that, in the event of intercommunal strife between the Turkish and Greek communities, the three guarantors could intervene jointly or separately. Turkey relied on this provision as its legal basis. The armed conflict after 1963, the long stationing of UN forces, the flow of Greek and Turkish weapons to the island, and the failure of the 1974 Geneva intercommunal talks to settle military-security questions led both sides to expect that the existing balance would be changed by the other. On 14 July, Turkey demanded an end to the flow of foreign weapons and the withdrawal of Greek military personnel. On 15 July, the Greek military junta took power in Athens, while a coup in Cyprus centered on EOKA B and Greek officers deposed Makarios and forced his evacuation with British assistance. Turkey landed on 20 July, stating that it was preventing a coup and protecting the Turkish Cypriot community. Although the Greek junta collapsed on 24 July, Turkey issued a second ultimatum on 30 July. It demanded a return of the National Guard to its former strength, specified an authorized level of 809 armed personnel, called for the withdrawal of military advisers, and required action concerning imported weapons. After mediation by Waldheim, the deadline was extended to 3 August. When the second phase began on 14 August, Turkey argued that the Cypriot side had violated the first cease-fire line and continued to receive weapons. The United Nations maintained that those arguments could not replace the obligation to observe the existing cease-fire.
impact: 第二次停火後，軍事前線被轉化為制度化的聯合國緩衝區；原先只圍住基里尼亞灘頭的臨時停火線，延伸為由西側法爾os至東側法馬古斯塔的長線，後來稱為「綠線」。聯合國部隊不僅封住前線，還控制道路通行、巡邏及談判地點，使雙方無法再以一次縱向推進改變全島局勢。軍隊方面，希臘軍事顧問陸續離開，馬卡里奧斯政府在八月解散國民衛隊的戰時編制，EOKA B也失去原有公開建制；土軍則留在北部與東部，與土耳其塞浦路斯部隊形成連續的防御區。安理會第357號決議把第二次軍事行動列為「進一步介入」，但沒有建立足以執行全面制決的強制機制，因此條約依據與聯合國憲章之間的爭議仍留在政治層面。此後的1975年協議談判與1977年高級別協議嘗試處理安全、軍隊及聯邦安排，卻沒有消除島上早已形成的兩套軍政控制區；軍事成果因此被固定在一條國際監督的線上，而不是被一項全面和平條約取代。
impactEn: After the second cease-fire, the military front was converted into an institutionalized UN buffer. The temporary line that had previously surrounded only the Kyrenia beachhead was extended into a long line running from the Paphos area in the west to Famagusta in the east, later called the Green Line. UN forces not only held the front but also controlled road access, patrolled the area, and supervised sites associated with negotiations, preventing either side from reversing the island's strategic situation with one more advance along a single axis. On the military side, Greek advisers departed, Makarios's government dissolved the wartime structure of the National Guard during August, and EOKA B lost its former public organization. Turkish troops remained in northern and eastern Cyprus alongside Turkish Cypriot forces, creating a continuous defense area. Security Council Resolution 357 described the second intervention as further military action, but the Council did not create an enforcement mechanism capable of compelling a general settlement, leaving the dispute between the treaty basis and the UN Charter at the political level. The negotiations of 1975 and the High-Level Agreement of 1977 later addressed security, armed forces, and federal arrangements, but they did not remove the two separate military-administrative zones. The result was a military status quo maintained along an internationally supervised line rather than a settlement imposed by a comprehensive peace treaty.
result: 至1974年8月16日，戰役的軍事結局已經形成：土耳其軍隊控制了基里尼亞、北岸走廊及法馬古斯塔大部分，與原來的西部小據點相比，土耳其塞浦路斯部隊首次取得大片連續土地；共和國政府仍控制南部、西部以及法爾os與利馬索爾等主要區域，首都尼科西亞的政府職能也繼續存在於南部控制區。雙方控制區之間留下聯合國緩衝帶，而不是任何一方完全包圍另一方。奧斯曼·法澤爾·波拉特率領的部隊沒有攻占全島，也沒有迫使馬卡里奧斯政府投降，卻完成了三項有限而具體的作戰目標：鞏固北部土耳其塞浦路斯聚落、突破塞方依山口與海岸公路建立的阻擊線，以及把法馬古斯塔與基里尼亞兩個戰區連接起來。格里瓦斯在第二階段返島後，短暫重建EOKA B的指揮中樞，但無法扭轉已被聯合國納入監督的停火。戰後，北部先於1975年形成「塞浦路斯土耳其聯邦邦」，1985年再宣布成立「北塞浦路斯土耳其共和國」，其國際承認僅來自土耳其；與此同時，綠線、聯合國部隊與雙方軍區一直延續。代號「阿提拉」的行動因此以兩階段軍事推進和受監督停火告終，而不是以全島征服或正式和約告終。
resultEn: By 16 August 1974, the military outcome of the operation had taken shape. Turkish troops controlled Kyrenia, the northern coastal corridor, and most of Famagusta. Compared with the small and separated Turkish Cypriot positions before the invasion, the Turkish Cypriot forces now held a broad continuous territory. The Republic of Cyprus retained the south, the west, and major areas including Paphos and Limassol, while the government's capital functions continued in the southern sector of Nicosia. A UN buffer separated the two zones; neither side completely encircled the other. The force commanded by Osman Fazıl Polat did not conquer the entire island or force the collapse of Makarios's government, but it accomplished three limited and concrete operational objectives: reinforcing the northern Turkish Cypriot positions, breaking Cypriot blocking lines established at mountain passes and along the coastal road, and connecting the Famagusta and Kyrenia sectors. After returning during the second phase, Grivas briefly rebuilt the EOKA B command center but could not reverse a cease-fire already placed under UN supervision. In the aftermath, the north formed the Turkish Federated State of Cyprus in 1975 and declared the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus in 1985, receiving international recognition only from Turkey. Meanwhile, the Green Line, UN forces, and the opposing military zones continued to exist. Operation Attila thus ended with two phases of military advance and a supervised cease-fire, not with conquest of the whole island or a formal peace treaty.
